faq: Usually {eta} from your deposit, depending on how quickly the brand dispatches. Your confirmation email includes an estimated delivery date.

Send an order request, no payment needed yet. Within 24 hours we email you to confirm stock, the final price and delivery date. You then pay a {deposit}% deposit by bank transfer; the balance is due once your items are consolidated and photographed, before they ship to Australia.
Shipping is {shipping}{first_free}. There is a {fee}% service fee on the item total. Every cost is shown in your bag before you order.
We only list verified brands: official website, official Instagram and registered business details. Every item is bought directly from the brand’s own store.
What if I pick the wrong size?
You can change sizes or cancel for free until we place the order with the brand. After that the brand’s exchange policy applies, and return postage is agreed case by case.
The item I want is sold out?
Tap "Notify me" and we’ll let you know as soon as the brand restocks.
content.about: We buy authentic pieces from independent Vietnamese fashion labels on your behalf, consolidate them in Vietnam and deliver to your door in Australia. Prices are converted at an indicative exchange rate; product images and details belong to each brand.
